# cci-fix-1 handoff

Brief: /Users/yasyf/.claude/scratch/release-v3/briefs/cci-fix-1.md. The owner order makes every cci bug a lane's job. The root sends cci defects to this lane by SendMessage. The lane's teammate mailbox (~/.claude/teams/session-67c0e5da/inboxes/cci-fix-1.json) did not deliver messages into the turn; they were found only by reading the mailbox file after desk-wait reported MAILBOX.

## Landed (all squash-merged on yasyf/cc-inbox main, CI green)

- v0.4.0: #12 lane attribution and parser-version reparse; #13 time-first lines; #14 digest seq order, runner events lane=runner topic=X; #15 --width (default 400).
- v0.5.0: #16 grep over whole rendered lines, literal by default, --regex; #17 sixteen watched kinds; #18 stack:/target: refs and tracking of imported holds, defects, and blockers until a matching later close; #19 state folds state records; #21 dating never places a stamp more than 5 minutes after file mtime; #20 drive use starts the session cursor at the drive head.
- Installed: ~/.local/bin/cci 0.5.0 (checksum-verified release tarball); the daemon com.yasyf.cc-inbox runs 0.5.0 (upgraded with cci serve). All 10 import sources are at parser 5.

## Notes

- Defect 6 needed no cci change: the } records are complete Oct 2-3 desk-runner lines; current desk-runner settle_launch records the whole output.
- Defect 7 freshness was already fixed by #11 (cc-inbox-2): 0.9 s from append to grep.
- HOLD lines must name stacks as <project>/<env> (stack:tunnel/tnt-usw2-1frg9c7) to be tracked; tunnel/T or box names cannot match.
- Do not import runner-state.md (rewritten view; produces junk desk-lane-* lanes).
- Pre-existing: TestCompact fails under TZ=Asia/Tokyo (CI runs UTC).
- Release mechanics: a chore(release): vX.Y.Z commit on main moves Unreleased into a dated section, then tag vX.Y.Z; release.yml takes about 7 minutes.
- Records: ccn notes 04fe6d9 and 2b29f86. Trial harness: /Users/yasyf/.claude/scratch/release-v3/cci-fix-1/trial.sh copies the live store, re-imports with a dev build, and diffs lane counts.

## Open

None. Worktree ~/.claude/worktrees/cc-inbox/cci-fix-1 removed; its branches are merged.
